8 virtues

An educational journey for
everyday life in prisons Everyday practice

12

O NOVO EU
The eight virtues of the journey

Humility Acceptance
Recognizing limits and reconsidering attitudes. Acting on what can be changed.

Individuation Helping Others
Reflecting on identity and choices. Practicing listening, cooperation and support.

Gentleness Selflessness
Responding calmly in difficult situations. Considering how one’s choices affect others.

Forgiveness Responsibility
Working through hurt and possibilities for a fresh start. Taking ownership of one’s role in decisions.
